# Transition Chapter Six: The Long Goodbye

## 1995–2005

---

In the end, it did not feel like a battle. Battles have momentum, reversals, moments of hope and despair. What Nancy had was an endurance contest with a finish line that kept moving, and the worst part—the part they do not tell you about, the part that no one prepares you for—was the waiting.

---
